title: nolana humifusa subsp. spathulata
intro: Nolana humifusa subsp. spathulata, commonly known as a type of flowering plant in the Four O'Clock family, is a species native to South America. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, and it has been traditionally used to treat various health issues, including fever, cough, and respiratory problems. The therapeutic actions of Nolana humifusa subsp. spathulata include expectorant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial activities, which contribute to its health benefits. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, glycosides, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
